notes: RetroArch (Game Boy, Game Boy Color, Game Boy Advance, Super Nintendo, Mega Drive, Mega CD, Nintendo 64), for RetroAchievements (plan retroarch): pkgforge-dev's sharun AppImage of RetroArch 1.22.2 (glibc 2.43, its own Mesa for GL; Vulkan forced onto the image's Turnip by the appimage-sharun format). Replaces armGBA, Snes9x and ClownMDEmu, and RMG for N64 (Phase 6). HW 2026-11-09, Air X (A610): Vulkan on Turnip, PipeWire, every core loads from an OGUI card.

Cores (catalog "cores", retroforge-emu installs them with the AppImage): armgba (armGBA's own libretro core, GitHub release, gb/gbc/gba), snes9x, genesis_plus_gx and mupen64plus_next (libretro buildbot nightly). system_args loads the system's core with -L; system_requires stops a game whose core is missing (not-installed: download RetroArch again, which reinstalls missing cores) and a Mega CD game without a BIOS of any region (missing-file). RetroArch's Online Updater, core updater and Load Core are hidden, and the buildbot URL is empty: players do not install cores for other systems (user decision 2026-11-09).

N64 (Mupen64Plus-Next): the aarch64 buildbot core is desktop GL only, so RetroArch switches from Vulkan to its GL driver for it (driver_switch_enable, seeded on: HW 2026-11-09, Air X, Super Mario 64 at full speed). Mupen64Plus-Next.opt seeds the core's own options file (global_core_options off = config/<core>/<core>.opt): GLideN64 (paraLLEl-RDP needs GPU features the A610 lacks), HLE RSP, the dynarec, as RMG ran. It writes Mupen64plus/ and shaders/ into ~/bios (accepted). RMG's saves are not migrated (user 2026-11-09): the core starts fresh <rom>.srm files in ~/saves/n64.

Seed retroarch.cfg (RetroArch rewrites the whole file on exit, so no comments; it keeps our keys, writing paths back as ~/...): Vulkan, PipeWire, the SDL2 joypad driver with our one autoconfig (retroforge-pad.cfg: InputPlumber's virtual Xbox Elite 2 pad, 045e:0b00 = 1118/2816, matched by ids; the AppImage ships no autoconfig, no assets, no core info); RGUI menu (needs no assets); system_directory = the flat ~/bios (Mupen64Plus-Next will write its Mupen64plus/ folder there: accepted); pause_nonactive off (gamescope focus).

system_settings: savefile_directory / savestate_directory = ~/saves/<system>, ~/states/<system> before every game, and sort_savefiles_enable / sort_savestates_enable off: on by default they put saves in a per-core subfolder (HW 2026-11-09). RetroArch writes its in-memory values back on exit, hence before every game, not only in the seed. Saves are <rom>.srm, as armGBA standalone named them.

Exit: one SIGTERM (OGUI's Exit) is RetroArch's normal quit in under a second, SRAM and config written (HW 2026-11-09); quit_press_twice only applies to the key. RetroArch's menu: Select + Start (input_menu_toggle_gamepad_combo 4); keyboard F5.

gamepad_profile guide-hotkeys.yaml: hold Guide for L1 load state, R1 save state, R2 fast-forward (held), Start quit (pressed twice) -- keyboard F1-F4 bound in the seed. RetroAchievements: hardcore off by default (D3; hardcore blocks loading states).
gui_args: RetroArch's menu, no content (Main menu > Emulators > Open).

achievements: the player's one RetroAchievements sign-in and Hardcore toggle (~/.config/retroforge/retroachievements.json, Settings > Library > RetroAchievements) written into retroarch.cfg before every start, RetroArch's quoting (plan standalone-cheevos): cheevos_enable off when signed out, cheevos_password always empty (only the token is kept). A sign-in in RetroArch's own menu is replaced at the next launch; RetroArch writing retroarch.cfg back 0644 at exit is tightened again then.
